blocks.text: ‘PIETA’ IN PASAY. The shot by Raffy Lerma, published by the Inquirer on July 24, 2016, shows a pedicab driver in the arms of his anguished partner after being killed by motorcycle-riding gunmen in Pasay City. The assailants also left a sign at the scene calling their victim a “pusher.” (Inquirer File Photo) MANILA, Philippines — Noel Celis’s pulse still races whenever a motorcyclist pulls up alongside him at a red light, a legacy of countless nights photographing ex-president Rodrigo Duterte’s bloody drug war. “They call it riding in tandem,” the freelance photographer told Agence France-Presse of the two-man teams that […]...
